name: google-shopping-flashdata
description: Search Google Shopping for products, merchants and price labels. Collect comparable offer snapshots with product IDs and source links. Uses the paid FlashData API.

FLASHDATA_API_KEY.title: FlashData API key
FLASHDATA_API_KEY.description: FlashData API key from https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys with google_shopping enabled. Data calls use paid Credits; pricing and job reads are free.
